uiai_epwa_delivery_v1.title: UIAI EPWA Delivery
uiai_epwa_delivery_v1.description: Fail-closed artifact delivery binding for a durable HTTPS EPWA viewer and portable package.

truth_notice.const: Artifact existence and EPWA delivery do not establish review, verification, completion, provider closure, settlement, or legal admissibility.

uiai_artifact_delivery_envelope_v2.title: UIAI Artifact Delivery Envelope
uiai_artifact_delivery_envelope_v2.description: Common REST and tool response envelope for artifact-producing operations. Raw artifact bytes and legacy paths are never delivery outputs; ready deliveries expose only bound HTTPS viewer and portable-package URLs.

uiai_evidence_artifact_commit_delivery_e.title: Committed Artifact Awaiting EPWA Publication
uiai_evidence_artifact_commit_delivery_e.description: HTTP 202: immutable artifact committed, but no valid EPWA package binding could be produced. Never a ready delivery; retry publication using the committed identity.
